meta.title: Irreverent Gluttony - 4
meta.description: Grand words and elegant phrasing cannot hide the emptiness of your heart.

units.rawText: ID MGEX-90F... Functions no longer sustainable, core Entropized...
units.displayText: ID MGEX-90F... Functions no longer sustainable, core Entropized...

spans.text: ID MGEX-90F... Functions no longer sustainable, core Entropized...

units.rawText: ID MGEX-90F... Requesting purification.
units.displayText: ID MGEX-90F... Requesting purification.

spans.text: ID MGEX-90F... Requesting purification.

units.rawText: Greater Sanctifier Eucharist, granting request.
units.displayText: Greater Sanctifier Eucharist, granting request.

spans.text: Greater Sanctifier Eucharist, granting request.

units.rawText: The girl puts her fist to chest, praying as Eosphorus did back then.
units.displayText: The girl puts her fist to chest, praying as Eosphorus did back then.

spans.text: The girl puts her fist to chest, praying as Eosphorus did back then.

units.rawText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.
units.displayText: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

spans.text: For we heed the revelations of God, and we act to carry out His will.

units.rawText: I got it right this time, Raven.
units.displayText: I got it right this time, Raven.

spans.text: I got it right this time, Raven.

units.rawText: Her chant finished, she thrusts the fork in her hand into the Lesser Sanctifier's core.
units.displayText: Her chant finished, she thrusts the fork in her hand into the Lesser Sanctifier's core.

spans.text: Her chant finished, she thrusts the fork in her hand into the Lesser Sanctifier's core.

units.rawText: Thank you... thank you... thank you...
units.displayText: Thank you... thank you... thank you...

spans.text: Thank you... thank you... thank you...

units.rawText: ...What's here to give thanks for?
units.displayText: ...What's here to give thanks for?

spans.text: ...What's here to give thanks for?

units.rawText: I'm killing you, taking away your life.
units.displayText: I'm killing you, taking away your life.

spans.text: I'm killing you, taking away your life.

units.rawText: Th... thank... tha...
units.displayText: Th... thank... tha...

spans.text: Th... thank... tha...

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifier's neural systems are no longer sufficient to sustain a conversation with Eucharist. It can only express its gratitude for its execution, as it orders would have it do.
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifier's neural systems are no longer sufficient to sustain a conversation with Eucharist. It can only express its gratitude for its execution, as it orders would have it do.

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifier's neural systems are no longer sufficient to sustain a conversation with Eucharist. It can only express its gratitude for its execution, as it orders would have it do.

units.rawText: ...Tch.
units.displayText: ...Tch.

spans.text: ...Tch.

units.rawText: The girl twists the weapon in her hand, silencing the thanks that was in truth nothing but a curse.
units.displayText: The girl twists the weapon in her hand, silencing the thanks that was in truth nothing but a curse.

spans.text: The girl twists the weapon in her hand, silencing the thanks that was in truth nothing but a curse.

units.rawText: What am I doing, really...
units.displayText: What am I doing, really...

spans.text: What am I doing, really...

units.rawText: Eucharist pulls back her weapon, surveying her surroundings.
units.displayText: Eucharist pulls back her weapon, surveying her surroundings.

spans.text: Eucharist pulls back her weapon, surveying her surroundings.

units.rawText: Eucharist was assigned to cleanup behind the frontlines of Ascension. Not long ago, she had engaged the Entropics here with Angelus.
units.displayText: Eucharist was assigned to cleanup behind the frontlines of Ascension. Not long ago, she had engaged the Entropics here with Angelus.

spans.text: Eucharist was assigned to cleanup behind the frontlines of Ascension. Not long ago, she had engaged the Entropics here with Angelus.

units.rawText: ID MGSD-20A, requesting purification.
units.displayText: ID MGSD-20A, requesting purification.

spans.text: ID MGSD-20A, requesting purification.

units.rawText: ID MGEX-97, infected...
units.displayText: ID MGEX-97, infected...

spans.text: ID MGEX-97, infected...

units.rawText: ID MGEX-78, infected...
units.displayText: ID MGEX-78, infected...

spans.text: ID MGEX-78, infected...

units.rawText: They might have claimed victory, but the Lesser Sanctifiers under her leadership fall one by one before the monsters' attacks.
units.displayText: They might have claimed victory, but the Lesser Sanctifiers under her leadership fall one by one before the monsters' attacks.

spans.text: They might have claimed victory, but the Lesser Sanctifiers under her leadership fall one by one before the monsters' attacks.

units.rawText: Former comrades litter the ground around her, infected by Entropy, begging for death with their final breaths.
units.displayText: Former comrades litter the ground around her, infected by Entropy, begging for death with their final breaths.

spans.text: Former comrades litter the ground around her, infected by Entropy, begging for death with their final breaths.

units.rawText: What a pain... eh?
units.displayText: What a pain... eh?

spans.text: What a pain... eh?

units.rawText: Even the person who spoke those words felt as if it were all abnormal.
units.displayText: Even the person who spoke those words felt as if it were all abnormal.

spans.text: Even the person who spoke those words felt as if it were all abnormal.

units.rawText: This ought to be a sad, holy affair. Why does she feel so frustrated?
units.displayText: This ought to be a sad, holy affair. Why does she feel so frustrated?

spans.text: This ought to be a sad, holy affair. Why does she feel so frustrated?

units.rawText: She shakes her head, trying to deny this emotion that should never have been felt in her neural cloud.
units.displayText: She shakes her head, trying to deny this emotion that should never have been felt in her neural cloud.

spans.text: She shakes her head, trying to deny this emotion that should never have been felt in her neural cloud.

units.rawText: You are no executioner, Eucharist.
units.displayText: You are no executioner, Eucharist.

spans.text: You are no executioner, Eucharist.

units.rawText: What you are doing is not slaughter. You are bestowing upon them a most divine blessing...
units.displayText: What you are doing is not slaughter. You are bestowing upon them a most divine blessing...

spans.text: What you are doing is not slaughter. You are bestowing upon them a most divine blessing...

units.rawText: <color=red>—Hehe.</color>
units.displayText: —Hehe.

spans.text: —Hehe.

units.rawText: Who's there?!
units.displayText: Who's there?!

spans.text: Who's there?!

units.rawText: She throws her weapon at the source of the laughter.
units.displayText: She throws her weapon at the source of the laughter.

spans.text: She throws her weapon at the source of the laughter.

units.rawText: BANG—
units.displayText: BANG—

spans.text: BANG—

units.rawText: Her operand-empowered fork easily penetrates her target's core.
units.displayText: Her operand-empowered fork easily penetrates her target's core.

spans.text: Her operand-empowered fork easily penetrates her target's core.

units.rawText: <color=red>Thank you... Tha... Th...</color>
units.displayText: Thank you... Tha... Th...

spans.text: Thank you... Tha... Th...

units.rawText: Did I mess up? No, wait...
units.displayText: Did I mess up? No, wait...

spans.text: Did I mess up? No, wait...

units.rawText: The muttered gratitudes around her only persist for a few seconds before returning to that laughing she so loathed.
units.displayText: The muttered gratitudes around her only persist for a few seconds before returning to that laughing she so loathed.

spans.text: The muttered gratitudes around her only persist for a few seconds before returning to that laughing she so loathed.

units.rawText: <color=red>Thank you... Hehe... Thank you... Hehe...</color>
units.displayText: Thank you... Hehe... Thank you... Hehe...

spans.text: Thank you... Hehe... Thank you... Hehe...

units.rawText: <size=40>AaaahhhHHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: AaaahhhHHHHH!

spans.text: AaaahhhHHHHH!

units.rawText: <size=40>Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up!</size>
units.displayText: Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up!

spans.text: Shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up, shut up!

units.rawText: She flails at the source of the laughter with her weapon.
units.displayText: She flails at the source of the laughter with her weapon.

spans.text: She flails at the source of the laughter with her weapon.

units.rawText: After returning to her senses and stopping her hands, there is nothing left around her save for piles of operand-ravaged remains.
units.displayText: After returning to her senses and stopping her hands, there is nothing left around her save for piles of operand-ravaged remains.

spans.text: After returning to her senses and stopping her hands, there is nothing left around her save for piles of operand-ravaged remains.

units.rawText: And...
units.displayText: And...

spans.text: And...

units.rawText: <color=red>He... Hehe... Hehehe...</color>
units.displayText: He... Hehe... Hehehe...

spans.text: He... Hehe... Hehehe...

units.rawText: The unceasing laughter, coming from her very own mouth.
units.displayText: The unceasing laughter, coming from her very own mouth.

spans.text: The unceasing laughter, coming from her very own mouth.
